sql: select date_trunc('day', started_at) as day, count(*) as cycles, max(started_at) as last_start, round(avg(new_terms+changed_terms)::numeric,1) as avg_new_changed, max(new_terms+changed_terms) as max_new_changed, round(avg(extract(epoch from finished_at-started_at))::numeric,1) as avg_secs, round(max(extract(epoch from finished_at-started_at))::numeric,1) as max_secs, round(avg(programs_listed)::numeric,0) as avg_listed, max(programs_listed) as max_listed, sum(errors) as errors from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '9 days' group by 1 order by 1
